title: 10/10 App, love it
body: I cannot recommend this app more. No pay walls, not a single real dollar spent. And so much depth to making goals fun. Create your own rewards and daily goals or habits and earn in game cash to buy rewards. Has made making my bed and hitting the gym work towards personalised rewards. Love it, definitely give it a go if you are looking for exterior motivation.
author: connor wentworth

title: It’s free
body: I don’t really understand the game but I like the fact that I can mark off my tasks and they don’t disappear. I’m not forced to pay a subscription to use this app, that’s a big plus for me.
author: possumfluff

title: Turning life into a game!
body: Didn't really have high hopes for this because I saw in-app purchases but I am so glad to be proven wrong! I have been looking for an app that can gameify my daily tasks for I can make my system more fun! Definitely not known enough but i am very grateful for its features! Thank you!
author: Dxrlinghaze

title: Hopeful
body:

author: myrin20

title: Amazing concept- a lot of bugs
body: I love this app but get a bit frustrated with it. On my iPhone 7 it seems to have a lot of bugs. Deleting things doesn't work. Sometimes I will open one task and it will open a completely different one. Refreshing doesn't work. Default tasks are extremely hard to edit/get rid of. A couple of people I have talked to with the app have similar problems.

body: Incredible user interface and just the features I need, and with a very motivating little “gimmick”. I’m actually excited about doing chores and not letting daily tasks lapse!

body: Unfortunately, it doesn't fit well in an iPhone 5 screen and it looks like alot of the images/graphics don't work either - at least on my phone.
author: Madaxe_munkee

title: Great for To Do lists and GTD Getting Things Done
body: Best app I've used so far for helping achieve daily tasks, improve good habits and discourage bad habits, and managing a GTD Getting Things Done approach to To Do lists. Very handy filtering. Key thing for me is the gameified approach to tasks. This is especially helpful if you join or form a party and start doing Quests. The incentive to compete Daily tasks and help defeat the monster and avoid damaging the party members has been enough of a mental nudge to really help me a lot with motivation. Plus it's fun and unobtrusive so that it doesn't get in the way of actual daily work. Great integration between fully featured website and the functional phone app. Nicely designed app too. Well done Habitica team.
author: KingOfJests

title: Best gamified task manager ever
body: This has actually organised my life. Finally!!!! Excellently covers the dailies and random todo's and so much more. Clear and easy to use. Ability to level up and unlock attributes etc is so good and does drive me to complete tasks.
author: krayg

title: Turn your To-Do list into a game
body:
Habitica makes your To-Do list fun by turning it into a game. Getting more things done in real life helps you to battle bosses, earn rewards and grow the little avatar.

The app itself is fairly buggy and could have more features hence only three stars. The features of the actual To-Do list are also less sophisticated than other apps and systems out there. 

However, it is functional enough to provide the basics and with some customisation can be tailored to suit different needs. The game aspect also helps to provide extra motivation to do a task you're on the fence about.

Overall, a pretty neat concept and app. I would recommend giving it a go
author: Lavenderbees

title: Excellent tie-in app
body: The app is an excellent tie-in with the website. It's not a replacement for the website but does an amazing job of keeping your habits and dailies (and feeding pets) up to date while you're on the run. The new update is superb and the interface is clean and simple, and works like a charm. Would definitely recommend to other Habitca users.
